# iosxe_interface_hsrp (Resource)

This resource can manage the Interface HSRP configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_interface_hsrp" "example" {
  type                    = "Vlan"
  name                    = "123"
  version                 = "2"
  bfd                     = true
  delay_minimum           = 100
  delay_reload            = 200
  mac_refresh             = 30
  use_bia                 = true
  use_bia_scope_interface = false
  standby_list = [
    {
      group_number        = 10
      authentication_text = "MySecret"
      ip                  = true
      ip_address          = "192.0.2.254"
      ip_secondary_addresses = [
        {
          address   = "192.0.2.253"
          secondary = true
        }
      ]
      preempt                       = true
      preempt_delay_minimum         = 30
      preempt_delay_reload          = 60
      preempt_delay_sync            = 120
      priority                      = 110
      timers_hello_interval_seconds = 3
      timers_hold_time_seconds      = 10
      tracks = [
        {
          number    = 1
          decrement = 20
          shutdown  = false
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `type` (String) Interface type
  - Choices: `GigabitEthernet`, `TwoGigabitEthernet`, `FiveGigabitEthernet`, `TenGigabitEthernet`, `TwentyFiveGigE`, `FortyGigabitEthernet`, `FiftyGigabitEthernet`, `HundredGigE`, `Vlan`, `Port-channel`, `Port-channel-subinterface/Port-channel`, `BDI`

### Optional

- `bfd` (Boolean) Enable HSRP BFD
  - Default value: `true`
- `delay_minimum` (Number) HSRP initialisation minimum delay
  - Range: `0`-`10000`
- `delay_reload` (Number) HSRP initialisation delay after reload
  - Range: `0`-`10000`
- `delete_mode` (String) Configure behavior when deleting/destroying the resource. Either delete the entire object (YANG container) being managed, or only delete the individual resource attributes configured explicitly and leave everything else as-is. Default value is `all`.
  - Choices: `all`, `attributes`
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `mac_refresh` (Number) Refresh MAC cache on switch by periodically sending packet from virtual mac address
  - Range: `0`-`255`
  - Default value: `10`
- `redirect_timers_advertisement` (Number) Redirect advertisement timer in seconds
  - Range: `10`-`180`
- `redirect_timers_holddown` (Number) Redirect holddown timer in seconds
  - Range: `30`-`3600`
- `redirect_unknown` (Boolean) Redirect to non-HSRP routers
  - Default value: `true`
- `standby_list` (Attributes List) HSRP group configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--standby_list))
- `use_bia` (Boolean) HSRP uses interface's burned in address
- `use_bia_scope_interface` (Boolean) Use-bia applies to all groups on this interface or sub-interface
- `version` (String) HSRP version
  - Choices: `1`, `2`
  - Default value: `1`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_interface_hsrp.example "<type>,<name>"
```
